title: PhyloLM-Style Behavioral Phylogeny of Safety Refusal Patterns

original_idea.body:
# PhyloLM-Style Behavioral Phylogeny of Safety Refusal Patterns

Adapt PhyloLM's distance-matrix + neighbor-joining method using safety-relevant fingerprints (refusal boundaries, harmfulness ratings); build a safety phylogeny of ~15 open models and compare to training phylogeny. Inference + tree construction (arXiv:2404.04671).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Level 3: plausible chain (safety-behavior phylogeny reveals concentration risk) but the catastrophic link is diagnostic/indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Level 4: adapt PhyloLM distance-matrix + neighbor-joining to safety fingerprints; well-documented inherited method.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Level 4: focused deliverable (safety vs training phylogeny) with probe-set construction as a dependency.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Level 4: ~15 public models, reusable concentration-risk diagnostic, no internal access.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference across ~15 open models + tree construction, single GPU over time.

novelty.reasoning: A safety-specific behavioral phylogeny (vs PhyloLM general behavior) appears largely novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: PhyloLM did general behavior; a safety-refusal phylogeny is plausibly novel.
